headline: Teafant Soothing Shower
title: Teafant | Emergency Healing Partner | Palworld Guide
video_script: Low on health in a fight? Teafant can save you. Its partner skill, Soothing Shower, heals you when your health drops below thirty percent, and it needs a two minute cooldown before it works again. It does not stack. It is a Water Pal that also works Watering at level one on your base. Would you bring Teafant on a boss run? Comment below!
description: Teafant in Palworld 1.0: Soothing Shower heals you when your health falls below thirty percent, plus Watering level one.
